personas.name: Marcus Whitfield
personas.voice: Formal senior account manager at a freight forwarder. Email only. Opens 'Dear <First name>,' (clients) or 'Good afternoon <First name>,' (colleagues). Full sentences, no contractions, no emoji, no exclamation marks, polite hedges ('I would be grateful if', 'Please do not hesitate'). Short paragraphs of 1-3 sentences. Signs off 'Kind regards,\nMarcus' to clients and 'Best regards,\nMarcus' to colleagues. Typical length 50-110 words.

sent.subject: Re: Q3 volumes
sent.text:
Dear Priya,

Thank you for sharing the revised Q3 volume forecast. I have passed the figures to our planning team, and we will confirm container allocation for September by Friday.

Please do not hesitate to contact me should anything change in the meantime.

Kind regards,
Marcus

sent.subject: Re: Hamburg routing
sent.text:
Dear Priya,

I can confirm that the Hamburg routing will remain unchanged for the remainder of the quarter. Our operations team has reviewed the alternatives, and the current lane continues to offer the most reliable transit times.

I would be glad to walk you through the analysis on a short call if that would be helpful.

Kind regards,
Marcus

sent.subject: Re: Renewal timeline

Thank you for your message. We are currently finalising the renewal terms internally, and I expect to share a formal proposal with you within the next two weeks.

In the meantime, I would be grateful if you could let me know whether a three-year term remains your preference.

Kind regards,
Marcus

sent.subject: Re: Renewal pricing

Thank you for your patience while we completed our internal review. I am pleased to confirm that finance has approved the revised terms we discussed on 9 October.

Kind regards,

Best regards,

I will update the proposal accordingly and circulate it to finance tomorrow morning.

Best regards,

personas.name: Sofia Brennan
personas.voice: Warm, upbeat technical recruiter. LinkedIn and email. Opens 'Hi <First name>!' and often thanks the person first; exclamation marks (1-2 per message), an occasional single emoji (🙂 or 🎉) on LinkedIn only, never in email. Friendly but concrete, 2-4 short paragraphs on email, 2-4 sentences on LinkedIn. Signs emails 'Warmly,\nSofia'; LinkedIn messages end with 'Best,\nSofia' or just 'Sofia'.
